hotels.title: A Contemporary Five-Star Stay on Shanghai’s West Nanjing Road
hotels.description: Rising above Jing’an, this polished five-star retreat places you moments from West Nanjing Road’s designer boutiques and the leafy avenues of the former French Concession. Contemporary rooms and suites pair sleek lines with marble bathrooms, while many look across Shanghai’s glittering skyline. Days can begin with a swim in the heated indoor pool or dim sum and Shanghainese favourites at the hotel’s Chinese restaurant. A short drive leads to Jing’an Temple, Zhangyuan’s restored shikumen lanes and the acclaimed tables of Ultraviolet and Fu He Hui
